opening.argument: The video presents an ABP News report on the Hathras case, with an on-location correspondent and questions about police placement and access to the affected family. It also examines restrictions on the broadcaster meeting victims and discusses reported rape-case statistics. Those are public-affairs subjects, not a deceptive offer or a request for viewers to participate. Although a subscription prompt is visible, it is ordinary audience engagement; nothing in the cited material ties it to a financial offer, a data request, or another scam mechanism.
